project.title: med_reminder
project.tagline: A local-first Flutter medication reminder and personal health utility app.

summary.short: med_reminder is a Flutter app for medication management and reminders with a local-first data model and an expanding personal health utility direction.
summary.long: Current work focuses on medicine data improvements, reminder workflows, and privacy-conscious local-first design. Additional personal health features are being evaluated separately; period tracking remains an unapproved proposal rather than committed roadmap scope.
